name: GhostBadge
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostBadge. Same span semantics plus variant, tone, and size. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes styles to this instance. Hand-written until GHO-13 generates manifests.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment. The default omits data-variant so CSS can treat a missing hook as soft.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color intent, independent of variant and not a status vocabulary. The default omits data-tone.

props.name: size
props.description: Compact type and padding. The default omits data-size so CSS can treat a missing hook as sm. Does not use control minimum sizes.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Short status or metadata text and optional decorative icon content. Icon-only use needs real hidden text (GhostVisuallyHidden), not aria-label on the span.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native span after mount; null before mount and after unmount. Delegates to the unstyled GhostBadge.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The native span inside the display:contents themed scope.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: Optional decorative icon content inside the default slot.
